resources.string: Choose actions for the supported buttons. With car Bluetooth audio, media buttons stay with the car to avoid duplicate commands.
Music and navigation on the original instruments
Publish song information and turn guidance to the original instrument widgets. The original instrument layout stays in control.
Applies after reconnecting CarPlay. Uses the verified 1920×532 projection display when available.
Validate while parked. The car may require its three-screen animation mode to make the map visible. DiPlay does not switch that mode; turn it off manually to restore the original instruments.
Vehicle changes apply after reconnecting CarPlay.

Reconnect CarPlay to apply. Uses the instrument screen instead of the map mode. Protocol negotiation and FX11 read-only data are available; native gauges need a verified CAF profile and renderer. No simulated vehicle values are sent.
Hide new-version prompts and stop background checks. Manual checks remain available; installing an official release replaces this customized build.
Send vehicle speed, gear and outside temperature when requested by the iPhone. Works without Ultra or GPS sharing. Applies after reconnecting CarPlay. Battery and electric range are not available.
Configure short and long presses separately. Long press requires a long-press event from the vehicle. Car-Bluetooth audio still handles ordinary media keys.

The map channel follows the dashboard style and takes effect after reconnecting CarPlay. Factory music and navigation follow dashboard switching. Configure buttons in Vehicle → Steering-wheel buttons.
